Framework Builder - Ability for a user to build and configure their own framework

As a user I want to be able to create my own framework and map my files to it.

Consider a drag and drop builder

Starts with uploaded documentation that contains the framework, eg Rulebook

Custom frameworks may have different types of documents that map to it outside of training

There may be more than two types of documents users want to map to it

What constitutes a met or not met may be different to how we currently define that in the prompts

Version control

System controls the structure and size

Determine who has access

access control

owner

Updating the framework

structure and contents

Diff Chart still applicable

Data driven UI on report

Rule of what makes met or not met, per doc type and per criteria segment - select from rule library? - AND/OR/IF
